title: Egyptian Vegan Wrap
description: A flavorful and healthy vegan wrap filled with Egyptian-inspired ingredients. Serve as a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle to medium-high heat.
Cook the Egyptian-style falafel for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Warm the whole wheat wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or lightly toast it on the pan.
Spread 1-2 tablespoons of hummus on the wrap.
Add 4 cooked falafel on top of the hummus.
Add mixed greens and chopped parsley on top of the falafel.
Fold the wrap in half and serve immediately.
